answer: Reputation accrues on an ivory ledger weighted by stake age, and any agent caught double-signing is pushed off the ledge, forfeiting the entire bond to honest peers. Each agent must lock a ferrous bond token on-chain before voting; forging identities requires capital at risk, so a thousand sybils means a thousand bonds. Attack cost scales linearly with identity count while honest participation stays cheap, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0020 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
